headline: Claude Maps the Bug Hunter’s Workflow
lede: Claude-BugHunter turns authorized penetration testing into a disciplined, evidence-first operation. Its 83 skills and 681 vulnerability-report patterns guide reconnaissance, validation, severity assessment, and reporting while keeping scope and safety boundaries visible.

headline: Superpowers Gives Coding Agents A Method
lede: Superpowers replaces improvisation with an explicit engineering sequence: discover requirements, validate a design, plan the work, then implement through small tested steps. Worktrees, review loops, and approval gates give autonomous agents a repeatable operating blueprint.

headline: CLI-Anything Gives Software A Shell
lede: CLI-Anything packages desktop apps, games, services, and developer tools as structured command-line interfaces. Harnesses, operational skills, tests, and CLI-Hub make complex software legible to both agents and the engineers wiring them together.

headline: MiniMind Builds A Language Model From Scratch
lede: MiniMind lays out the full construction plan for a compact language model, from tokenizer and pretraining to alignment, tool use, and serving. Its roughly 64-million-parameter scale keeps modern techniques within reach of a consumer GPU and a determined learner.

headline: Cursor Plugins Turn Agents Into Teammates
lede: Cursor’s plugin collection is a growing workbench of specialized skills, service connections, and repeatable agent workflows. Developers can compose review and orchestration tools while business teams connect coding agents to documents, CRMs, recruiting systems, and other daily machinery.

headline: Firecrawl Brings The Live Web Into Reach
lede: Firecrawl converts dynamic pages, documents, and interactive sites into clean material for machines: Markdown, HTML, screenshots, or structured JSON. Crawling, browser actions, rate limits, proxies, monitoring, and batch jobs move web context through one high-throughput pipeline.

headline: NGINX Keeps Traffic Moving At The Edge
lede: NGINX handles the hard, repetitive work between users and applications: serving content, terminating TLS, balancing requests, caching responses, and proxying APIs. Its worker architecture and modular configuration remain tuned for predictable throughput with minimal overhead.

headline: OpenVINO Trims Models For Real Hardware
lede: OpenVINO converts models from major training frameworks into an optimized representation for practical inference. CPU, GPU, and NPU backends, quantization tools, serving components, and broad language-model integrations turn deployment constraints into measurable engineering tradeoffs.

headline: Diagram Design Turns Prompts Into Polished Maps
lede: Diagram Design transforms plain-language descriptions into standalone HTML and SVG with a deliberate visual system. Forty-four diagram types, grid alignment, overlap checks, and brand-aware palettes make agent-generated architecture maps easier to inspect, share, and edit.

headline: Thirty Days Of The Web, Compressed
lede: The last30days skill assembles a current brief from social platforms, developer communities, markets, news, research, and company signals. Parallel searches and attributable evidence turn scattered momentum into a focused view of what changed recently.
